card.name: Inside drug names, early syllables
card.fires_on: The pole responds to the early syllable of a drug name that has been split into pieces, such as the fl in leflunomide, the ip in imipenem or the ind in perindopril. It appears in drug label text.

modes.label: Start of generic name
modes.description: An early piece of a generic drug name, with the rest of the name still to come.

modes.label: Brand name start
modes.description: The second piece of a brand name such as Avastin.

card.writes: Little clear signal; the promoted tokens are Chinese position words and English prefixes, which do not fit the pattern.
card.plain: It fires partway through a drug name that is still being spelled out, before the ending arrives.
